'''Wilkinson''' (Japanese: '''ワタナベ''' ''Watanabe'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[DP124|To Thine Own Pokémon Be True!]]''. He beat {{Ash}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} in the [[Pokémon Ping Pong Tournament]] with his {{p|Farfetch'd}}. He then lost to {{an|Dawn}} and {{TP|Dawn|Ambipom}}.
